brief:
The editors of the anthology "Palestine is Everywhere"—Skye Arundhati Thomas, Edwin Nasr, and Gloria Habsburg—have launched a new digital platform under the same name, according to ArabLit. The site will host a series of monthly commissions designed to support and amplify Palestinian writers and cultural work on an ongoing basis.

The initiative expands beyond the original anthology project, establishing a permanent venue for literary contributions rather than a single published collection. By commissioning new pieces at regular intervals, the platform creates sustained opportunity for Palestinian voices to reach audiences and build a body of work over time.
